notes: Verification was off (--no-verify): model claims whose quoted evidence is not on the page are reported as if it were. This run is for measurement only.

A layer lay over the viewport when the page was read (div, on top at 89% of the points sampled: a consent backdrop, a dialog): it was hidden while images, labels and contrast were captured, so the pixels measured are the page's own.
6 image(s) were left without a capture, so no judgment looked at them: 6 outside the page (an off-canvas menu). The snapshot says why for each (native.imageSkipped).

Not checked on a single page: 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation, 3.2.4 Consistent Identification and 3.2.6 Consistent Help compare the pages of a site, 2.4.5 Multiple Ways lists the ways to find them, and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks needs them to tell the blocks that repeat from the content; crawl its address with --crawl or --sitemap.
